ideas.title: Voter Roll Investigations: A Growing Trend?
ideas.description: This story would investigate the growing trend of voter roll investigations across the United States, with a focus on Minnesota and other states. The angle would be to assess the impact of these investigations on election security and the potential for voter suppression.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to examine the methodologies used in these investigations and their potential impact on marginalized communities.
